Attention Shoppers - buckle up for an AI Agent shopping on Amazon!  

Report suggest Amazon and Meta are talking about connecting MUSE directly to Amazon’s online store - which if true marks a reversal by Amazon.   

Speculation indicates Amazon leaders are concerned that integrating 3rd party shopping agents could weaken Amazon’s direct relationship with consumers >> er go any potential agreement will need sign off by the top leaders on both sides!  https://techcrunch.com/2026/11/25/amazon-and-meta-reportedly-in-talks-to-lift-blockade-on-ai-agent-muse/ #Amazon #Muse #AIAgents #Shopping #OnlineShopping #Meta #Marketplace #AgenticAI #AI
